summary: Live PR ownership enforcement is globally broken on main@914d0a2: the trusted-validator step copies swarmctl_hardening.py into RUNNER_TEMP but not its imported sibling swarmctl_hardening_base.py. Every PR using the hardened path can fail before ownership validation with ModuleNotFoundError. Repair the workflow materialization/import closure before treating Swarm Control Plane PR failures as lane-specific ownership failures.
evidence: PR #280 Swarm Control Plane run 31464861511, job 93695555543, step 'Enforce live ownership with trusted code' fails: ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'swarmctl_hardening_base'.
main .github/workflows/swarm-control.yml materializes only tools/swarm/swarmctl.py and tools/swarm/swarmctl_hardening.py into RUNNER_TEMP/trusted-swarm before invoking the hardened validator.
The same run's engine-tests job succeeds, confirming this is trusted-validator materialization rather than the lane test diff.
